Advanced Urinary Care
The Penn Vet Advanced Urinary Care service is tailored specifically for patients with
both upper and lower urinary tract disease. We provide an integrated experience for patients that suffer from conditions related to kidneys, the bladder, and related organ systems.
Learn More
Anesthesia
Our service develops tailored anesthetic plans based on your pet’s needs, history, and physical exam, ensuring the safest and most effective approach.
Learn More
Behavior Medicine
Our clinical team members combine skills from behavioral and other branches of veterinary medicine to address your pet’s behavior needs.
Learn More
Cardiology
The Cardiology Service at Penn Vet’s Ryan Veterinary Hospital is considered the birthplace of specialty veterinary medicine. Today, the Service continues this tradition by offering state-of-the-art treatment and diagnostic services such as echocardiography, electrocardiography, radiography, angiography, and 24-hour ambulatory ECG (Holter) monitoring.
Learn More
Comprehensive Cancer Care
We provide a comprehensive assessment of each patient’s cancer care needs, and work with our pet owners and their primary veterinarians to navigate through diagnosis and subsequent treatment plan.
Learn More
Dentistry & Oral Surgery
The Dentistry & Oral Surgery Service diagnoses and treats a wide variety of oral diseases in dogs, cats, and various special species.
Learn More

AAHA Accredited
Penn Vet Ryan Hospital is proud to be an AAHA-accredited veterinary hospital, a distinction held by fewer than 15% of veterinary practices in North America. By choosing an AAHA-accredited practice, you are choosing one that holds itself to rigorous standards and continuous improvement.

a family’s first pet
Our puppy had to have surgery for a foreign object obstruction, and everyone took such good care of her. Every person that we interacted with was friendly and helped us understand what was happening and our options. She is our first puppy, and this was overwhelming for us, and you all supported us every step of the way.
Sarah and Kyle
